verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Render integrating with an organization's identity provider (SSO/SAML/OIDC login or IdP-gated access) to protect internal apps, deployments, or agents. Managed OIDC only issues short-lived tokens so services can call Anthropic/OpenAI, MCP OAuth is a sign-in to Render itself, and private networking is a network control rather than identity-based access. All of these are adjacent features.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can secure internal apps, deployments, and agents using my organization's identity provider
